remediation.fix_approach: Applied optional chaining (?.) with nullish coalescing (?? '') to all four f.content.substring() calls in splitField() and cutField() in ScreenProcessorService. Null content now yields empty string instead of throwing TypeError.
remediation.root_cause: splitField() computed contentLen via f1.content?.length ?? 0 (null-safe) but then called f1.content.substring() (not null-safe) — inconsistency causing TypeError when field.content is null and a transformation rectangle overlaps the field. Same pattern in cutField() at two locations.
remediation.verification_needed: Verify screen renders correctly when ApplinX API returns a field with null content alongside transformation rectangles. Session should not freeze.
remediation.defense_in_depth: VULN-012 MAX_FIELDS guard also limits the damage surface by capping iteration depth.
remediation.testing: Unit test: call splitField({content: null, ...}, rect) — should return two fields with empty content, no exception. Call cutField({content: null, ...}, rect) — should return field with empty content.
remediation.residual_risk: Low. Empty string is semantically correct for a null-content field in the rendering context.
